about_short_description.short_description: United Arab Bank is a Financial company specializes in financial services industries and retail banking solutions.

product.name: Corporate Banking
product.description: Banking services for small, medium-sized, large, multinational, government, and financial institution customers, including lending, trade finance, cash management, and treasury solutions.

product.name: Personal Banking Accounts
product.description: Current and savings accounts for individuals, supporting everyday payments, deposits, salary arrangements, and routine banking transactions.

product.name: Personal Finance and Loans
product.description: Consumer financing for personal needs, homes, vehicles, overdrafts, and eligible sustainable purchases, with options for UAE nationals and expatriates.

product.name: Credit and Debit Cards
product.description: Payment cards for purchases, cash access, online transactions, and installment-based repayment, including debit cards and multiple Mastercard credit card tiers.

product.name: Islamic Banking
product.description: Sharia-compliant personal and corporate banking products, including accounts, deposits, cards, financing, corporate solutions, and Islamic wealth management.

product.name: Term and Investment Deposits
product.description: Fixed, flexible, escalating, call, floater, and Islamic deposit products for customers seeking to place funds for defined periods or maintain access to liquidity.
